# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The lists' change callbacks, one per list. See the generator's docstring for
# why a list without one of these is invisible rather than merely inert.

bag_wtp__zone_africa_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		cmm_apply_list_change = {
			setting = bag_wtp__zone_africa
		}
		bag_wtp_zone_changed = yes
	}
}

# Picking a good rewrites the recipe list underneath it, so the two callbacks are
# not symmetrical: the first refills, the second only reads.
bag_wtp__good_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		cmm_apply_list_change = {
			setting = bag_wtp__good
		}
		bag_wtp_read_good = yes
		bag_wtp_only_one_good = yes
		bag_wtp_fill_recipes = yes
		bag_wtp_recipe_reset = yes
	}
}

bag_wtp__recipe_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		cmm_apply_list_change = {
			setting = bag_wtp__recipe
		}
		bag_wtp_read_recipe = yes
		bag_wtp_only_one_recipe = yes
		bag_wtp_apply_method = yes
		bag_wtp_count_wanted = yes
	}
}

# The result table is read-only -- there is nothing to tick in it. It still needs
# a callback, because that is what makes the rows visible at all.
bag_wtp__result_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}

	effect = {
		cmm_apply_list_change = {
			setting = bag_wtp__result
		}
	}
}
